verdict.rationale: Marlin is driven by giving it a research topic and refining direction through a brief exchange with the user, after which it runs autonomously. This is natural-language task initiation built into the product itself. But natural-language control is only documented for setting up a run, not for operating the product more broadly or steering it during execution. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that input is free-form natural language, natural-language control beyond initial topic-setting (mid-run steering, managing runs or outputs), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Give it a research topic, and Marlin works autonomously for up to roughly eight hours
Sakana Marlin sharpens the direction of the investigation through a brief exchange with the user. Once the course is set, it works without further human input
Create a research plan based on the requested topic.
